audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Ziggs five of seven stages; the already-audited mirror settled on Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Malphite / Skill / Skill against 762 games at 50.66%. diffRating 4/10 and 'Favoured matchup' overstate it the same way.
audit.why: Granite Shield refunds poke that is not applied on cadence, and level 6 belongs to Malphite outright — Unstoppable Force is his one reach and it lands.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 4 and 6 flipped as one group across both layers with ratings; difficulty moved to 5.5/10 and carry threat to 6/10 in all three places.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Malphite cooldowns anywhere; level 6 was described as a Ziggs stage.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force 130s at rank 1 at 1000 range, Seismic Shard a flat 8s at 625, Ground Slam 7s — those set every step-up.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[2..4].why, phases[6].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three real errors. Unstoppable Force is called 'a point-and-click dash' — Riot's text says he launches himself to a LOCATION, so it is dodgeable. Granite Shield (10% max HP, recharges when he is not hit) is never mentioned at all. And Ground Slam's damage scaling off his own Armor is missing, while wants.foe[1] credits his armour stacking to 'W passive', which Thunderclap does not do.
audit.why: Granite Shield recharging is the single reason Ziggs must poke on his 5s Q cadence rather than in bursts; and telling a player a dodgeable dash is point-and-click removes the play that wins the fight.
audit.corrected: Location-dash wording in spikes[1]; Granite Shield's absorb and recharge in phases[2].why, report[5] and whys[2]; Ground Slam's Armor scaling in phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[1]; Thunderclap named as the auto-reset tell in dontsFull[0].d.

edits.after: Chip him below 60%, but Ground Slam's damage scales off his own Armor, so his armour stacking is damage too — never bait his walk-up.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 and 1000 range — his one reach. Hold Satchel for the landing, never spend it early.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: Your 5000-range R decides sieges, but a banked Unstoppable Force decides fights — never group up in a straight line.

edits.before: Track Malphite’s Unstoppable Force: Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 at 1000 range and knocks you up; Granite Shield soaks 10% of his max HP and recharges if you stop poking.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1 — usually banked for teamfights, so punish lane passivity while it is down. - Seismic Shard is a flat 8s at 625 and steals your move speed. - Ground Slam is 7s and scales with his Armor. - Satchel is for the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: That is Malphite’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: His Thunderclap wind-up is the tell — step back on the animation, not the cast.

edits.after: Level 6 Unstoppable Force is 130s of one-shot engage you must dodge.

edits.before: Late game you out-range him whenever his R is down.

edits.before: His R Unstoppable Force is the whole matchup: it's a point-and-click dash that flips it, so once he's 6 respect his all-in and keep W Satchel charged to knock yourself out of his engage line.
edits.after: His R Unstoppable Force is the whole matchup: a 130s charge to a location that knocks you up, so from 6 respect his all-in and keep W Satchel charged to blast out of the landing zone.
